## World

The US Department of Homeland Security ordered federal agencies to remove products from Chinese AI company Deepseek, prompting sharp criticism and retaliation threats from Beijing. While Washington cites national security and data access concerns, China maintains strict barriers against foreign AI services like ChatGPT and Claude. Analysts note that both nations increasingly leverage national security frameworks to protect domestic markets.

## Science

Hospitals and healthcare institutions must stop treating artificial intelligence like traditional software, as patients and doctors increasingly adopt these tools independently. Roughly a third of Americans have utilized AI for health information, while clinical reference tools like OpenEvidence have experienced massive growth among physicians. Experts emphasize that adopting flawed mental models remains a primary bottleneck for enterprise AI integration.

## Technology

NVIDIA showcased its comprehensive lineup of local AI hardware during the GTC Berlin event, including the RTX Spark, DGX Spark, and DGX Station systems. The newly launched hardware provides developers and enterprises with powerful on-device AI compute capabilities and personal agent support. Additionally, NVIDIA announced numerous software integrations, workflow updates, and day-0 model support for the platform.
